verdict.rationale: Mercury documents international payouts: international wires in the dashboard and API [mercury-docs-46, mercury-docs-53], plus no-fee USD payments around the globe [mercury-docs-7]. Nothing in the evidence says these payments settle in under a minute, which is the defining part of the story, so this only partially delivers. Missing for 10: any evidence of near-instant cross-border settlement, documented international transfer delivery times, independent or hands-on corroboration of speed.
